news.title: 'Senseless': 2 young brothers killed in DeKalb shooting after potential childhood dispute
news.summary: Brothers Jamarion Rolle, 11, and Jahki Clark, 12, were killed in a shooting at a Stone Mountain apartment complex.

news.title: Young brothers killed in tragic Stone Mountain shooting identified as police search for suspect
news.summary: Family members shared photos of the two brothers with 11Alive. One showed Jamarion wearing a Daffy Duck shirt. Another showed Jahki holding a school certificate.

news.title: Gunman sought after two boys killed in DeKalb County apartment shooting
news.summary: Investigators continue to search for a the shooter who killed two boys outside of their Dekalb County apartment off North Hairston Road. The boys were 11 and 12 years old.

news.title: Man arrested for 2019 Atlanta house party shooting that left 1 dead
news.summary: A suspect wanted in connection with a deadly March 2019 shooting in Atlanta was arrested Wednesday in Roanoke, Alabama, according to police.

news.title: 3 alleged gang members arrested in Atlanta summer crime crackdown
news.summary: Georgia prosecutors secured guilty pleas and sentences for three men tied to a Los Angeles-based street gang following an extensive multi-agency investigation in Atlanta.

news.title: Final missing Hurricane Helene victim in Tennessee found
news.summary: Human remains discovered by debris removal specialists in the Jackson Island area belong to Nancy Tucker, the final missing person in Washington County after Hurricane Helene devastated the region two

news.title: 2 boys killed, 2 women injured in deadly shooting at Stone Mountain home, police say
news.summary: Police said that 11-year-old and 12-year-old boys were tragically killed in the shooting that stemmed from a disagreement earlier in the day.
